hunts.title: Los Angeles
hunts.tagline: Palm trees, big signs and a whole lot of sunshine.

finds.title: The Hollywood Sign
finds.look: The white letters on the hill, readable in the photo. Any distance counts.

finds.title: A star on the Walk of Fame
finds.look: One pink terrazzo star with a name on it.

finds.title: A street lined with palm trees
finds.look: At least four tall palms in a row along a street.

finds.title: Santa Monica Pier
finds.look: The pier's Ferris wheel, the roller coaster, or the arched entrance sign.

finds.title: Griffith Observatory
finds.look: The white building with its three domes.

finds.title: A taco truck
finds.look: A food truck or stand selling tacos, with the menu or window in view.

finds.title: A giant mural
finds.look: A painted mural at least as tall as a person, on an outside wall.

finds.title: The Getty Center
finds.look: The white stone buildings on the hill, or its garden.

finds.title: The Venice canals
finds.look: A canal with a small bridge or houses along the water.

finds.title: Walt Disney Concert Hall
finds.look: The curving stainless-steel walls downtown.

hunts.title: San Francisco
hunts.tagline: Hills, fog, cable cars and one very orange bridge.

hunts.title: Rainy Day at Home

finds.look: Something reflected clearly in a puddle.

finds.look: A lifeguard stand or tower.

finds.look: A trail of footprints, paw prints or bird tracks.

finds.look: An umbrella planted in the sand.

finds.title: A sunset over the water

finds.title: A seabird
finds.look: A gull, pelican or other seabird.
